source.name: Shift+Tab from the first control in a modal must wrap to the modal's last control
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/28481) at 85364745831ba5513ee7e940fe571cb4268810b8. Blind to the maintainers' fix 7646f6bd33a03132e446fb060880bbf051a1639f; routing auto.

journey.title: Move backwards through the delete confirmation
journey.goal: Shift+Tab from the first control wraps to the Delete button

functionalJourney.title: Delete the project with the mouse
functionalJourney.goal: Confirming deletes the project and closes the modal

guards.title: Tab forwards through the confirmation and cancel
guards.goal: Forward Tab order reaches Cancel, which closes the modal

plan.root_cause: The modal's focus trap only returns focus to the modal container when focus leaves, causing Shift+Tab from the first focusable element to move focus outside then back to the modal container, rather than wrapping to the last focusable element inside the modal.
plan.repair_strategy: Add keydown listener to handle Tab and Shift+Tab keys to wrap focus between first and last focusable elements within the modal, while preserving existing focus trap for clicks outside.

    super(element)

    this._config = this._getConfig(config)
    this._dialog = SelectorEngine.findOne(SELECTOR_DIALOG, this._element)
    this._backdrop = this._initializeBackDrop()
    this._isShown = false
    this._ignoreBackdropClick = false
    this._isTransitioning = false
    this._scrollBar = new ScrollBarHelper()

edits.after:
constructor(element, config) {
    super(element)

    this._config = this._getConfig(config)
    this._dialog = SelectorEngine.findOne(SELECTOR_DIALOG, this._element)
    this._backdrop = this._initializeBackDrop()
    this._isShown = false
    this._ignoreBackdropClick = false
    this._isTransitioning = false
    this._scrollBar = new ScrollBarHelper()
    this._keydownHandler = null
  }

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Shift+Tab from the first focusable element (close button) will now move focus to the last focusable element (delete button) inside the confirmation modal, allowing reverse navigation to wrap as expected.
functional_risks: Possible interference with custom keyboard handlers if modal contains other elements with custom keydown logic.
Risk of breaking if modal markup changes and the focusable element selector no longer matches the intended elements.
Potential performance impact if many focusable elements are present (though negligible).
Ensure that the listener is properly removed on modal hide/dispose to avoid memory leaks.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab cycles through focusable elements in order: close button → name input → cancel button → delete button → close button.
Verify that pressing Shift+Tab cycles in reverse order: delete button → cancel button → name input → close button → delete button.
Verify that modal still traps focus when clicking outside or pressing Escape.
Verify that modal close button (X) still works and dismisses modal.
Verify that the underlying functionality (deleting project on confirm) remains unchanged.
